findings.title: Formation through joining and care
findings.claim: The command can also be heard against an image of a relation being made durable by binding, accepting, and continuing formation.
findings.mechanism: The focus form رَبَّ carries the supplied tight-knot facet, while the following feeding form supplies the independent graft and continuous-formation cues; their contact makes care appear as an operation that binds and develops what it receives.
findings.reader_payoff: The Lord-House relation gains a concrete picture of belonging being secured and carried forward, alongside the plain command to worship.
findings.containment: The focus remains a command to worship the Lord of the House. Knotting, grafting, and formation are a contextual resonance supplied by the contact with 106:4, not replacements for either focus word.

epistemic.reason: The trusted channel record supplies exact focus and sequel carriers, but the cross-domain formation relation remains an interpretive synthesis.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Başka bir kullanımda çözülmesi güç, sıkıca bağlanmış düğümü bildirir.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus noun carries the supplied tight-knot facet as a relation of secured joining.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The following feeding action supplies an independent image of receiving and maintaining what is joined.
branch_activations.activation: The knot facet meets the feeding contact at the Lord of the House, turning lordly care into a binding operation.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The relation can be perceived as one that accepts and holds a dependent element while it is brought onward.
branch_activations.boundary: This does not make the plain noun mean knot in isolation or erase its Lord-of-the-House construction.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Grafting and accepting an insertion
branch_activations.carrier: The following feeding verb carries the supplied graft and accepted-insertion image.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus Lord relation supplies the independent receiving and maintaining context.
branch_activations.activation: A fed recipient and a graft accepted into a living stock meet as an image of care incorporating what it sustains.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Provision becomes newly legible as incorporation into a living relation, while the verse still says that they are fed.
branch_activations.boundary: The context verb remains feeding in the primary reading; grafting is an attributed resonance.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: Worship can be seen as a response within a process that keeps a community in formation.
branch_activations.boundary: No developmental process is asserted as the literal lexical meaning of أَطْعَمَهُم.

findings.mechanism: The preceding repeated affiliation form supplies joining after separation, and the focus worship form carries the supplied dispersed-groups facet; their contact turns House-centered service into a response that gathers what travel has spread.
findings.reader_payoff: The plural commanded group appears within a movement from dispersed routes toward one House, adding spatial direction to the plain instruction.
findings.containment: The command still means worship. Gathering and dispersal describe the contextual image made by the preceding affiliation and the focus branch; the verb is not translated as gather.

epistemic.reason: The trusted channel record has exact context occurrences and a focus occurrence, while the reversal from dispersal to convergence remains an inference.
